title: What If Humans Never Invented Marriage?
tags: what if humans never invented marriage
description:
You get down on one knee in the middle of a restaurant. You open the box. And the woman you love looks down at you and says: "Is your knee okay?" Because in this world, nobody ever invented marriage. No weddings. No husbands. No wives. Not even the word.

At first it sounds great. No $34,000 party. No seating chart. No divorce lawyers. And nobody, anywhere, has in-laws. Then you meet Rico. Then comes the bad day. And then you do the one thing that makes you the most hated man in town: you try to invent it yourself.

In this video: the one rule every relationship runs on in a world with no marriage, the real people in southwest China who live almost exactly like this (the Mosuo and their "walking marriage"), why the first weddings in Mesopotamia had almost nothing to do with love, when marrying for love actually became normal, and what the promise is really for.

So which one are you in a world with no marriage? Comment PROMISE or FREE.

Subscribe so you don't miss the next world. It gets even stranger.

title: What If We Had Never Invented Clothes? The Naked Truth of Evolution
description:
What If We Had Never Invented Clothes?
Imagine a world where no one ever put on a single garment. What would our civilization look like? Could humans have spread across the planet, survived the Ice Age, and built cities? In this video, we break down how clothing shaped evolution, health, culture, and the entire history of humanity.
In this video:
0:00 Intro: a world without clothes
1:10 When and why the first clothing appeared
3:00 How humans would have survived without it: climate and migration
5:15 Health: parasites, injuries, disease
7:20 How society and culture would change
9:30 Fashion, status, and identity: what we would lose
11:00 Final thoughts: could we have done without clothes?
Fascinating facts from the video:
🔹 Scientists estimate the age of clothing by studying the evolution of body lice: roughly 100,000 to 170,000 years
🔹 Without clothes, humans likely couldn't have settled the colder regions of Earth
🔹 Clothing influenced not only survival but also social norms and the concept of modesty
Enjoyed the video? Give it a 👍, subscribe to the channel, and tell us in the comments what you think a world without clothes would look like!
